description: Source code for the 'fetch-pack' functionality in Git, handling object negotiation, shallow fetches, packfile retrieval, and communication with remote repositories.

methods.name: print_verbose
methods.description: Prints verbose messages if verbosity is enabled in args.

methods.name: cache_one_alternate
methods.description: Caches an alternate object if not already marked.

methods.name: for_each_cached_alternate
methods.description: Iterates over cached alternate objects and applies a callback.

methods.name: die_in_commit_graph_only
methods.description: Handles error when object is in commit graph but missing from object database.

methods.name: deref_without_lazy_fetch
methods.description: Dereferences an object ID to a commit, handling tags and lazy fetch logic.

methods.name: rev_list_insert_ref
methods.description: Inserts a ref's object ID into the negotiator's tip list.

methods.name: rev_list_insert_ref_oid
methods.description: Inserts a ref's object ID into the negotiator's tip list, used as callback.

methods.name: consume_shallow_list
methods.description: Processes shallow/unshallow lines from the server response.

methods.name: get_ack
methods.description: Parses ACK/NAK responses from the server during negotiation.

methods.name: send_request
methods.description: Sends a request buffer over the network, using sideband if enabled.

methods.name: insert_one_alternate_object
methods.description: Inserts an object into the negotiator's list of alternates.

methods.name: next_flush
methods.description: Calculates the next flush size based on whether sideband is used.

methods.name: mark_tips
methods.description: Marks the tips (heads) for negotiation.

methods.name: send_filter
methods.description: Sends filtering options if specified.

methods.name: find_common
methods.description: Negotiates common objects with the remote, handling shallow info and pack retrieval.

methods.name: add_shallow_requests
methods.description: Adds shallow/deepen requests to the fetch request buffer.

methods.name: add_wants
methods.description: Adds wanted objects to the fetch request buffer.

methods.name: add_common
methods.description: Adds common objects to the fetch request buffer.

methods.name: add_haves
methods.description: Adds 'have' objects to the fetch request buffer during negotiation.

methods.name: write_fetch_command_and_capabilities
methods.description: Writes the fetch command and capabilities to the request buffer.

methods.name: send_fetch_request
methods.description: Sends a fetch request with capabilities and options.

methods.name: process_section_header
methods.description: Processes and optionally peeks at a section header in server response.

methods.name: process_ack
methods.description: Processes ACK/NAK responses during negotiation.

methods.name: receive_shallow_info
methods.description: Processes shallow info section from server response.

methods.name: cmp_name_ref
methods.description: Comparison function for ref names.

methods.name: receive_wanted_refs
methods.description: Processes wanted-refs section from server response.

methods.name: receive_packfile_uris
methods.description: Processes packfile-uris section from server response.

methods.name: do_fetch_pack_v2
methods.description: Performs the fetch pack operation using protocol v2, handling negotiation, shallow info, and pack retrieval.

methods.name: fetch_pack
methods.description: Main function to fetch objects, handling protocol version differences and shallow updates.

methods.name: update_shallow
methods.description: Updates shallow info based on remote response and local settings.

methods.name: negotiate_using_fetch
methods.description: Performs object negotiation using fetch, handling multiple rounds and ACKs.

methods.name: report_unmatched_refs
methods.description: Reports refs that could not be matched on the remote.
